chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad narrated from Ibn Mahbub, from al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn al-Mughira, Abu Abdillah, al-Bushanji, al-Iraqi, who said:
Confused in madhhab, trustworthy in his narration.

key_terms.مُضْطَرِبُ الْمَذْهَبِ: Confused in madhhab (theological or jurisprudential stance)

ai.seo_question: What is the biographical status of al-Husayn ibn Ahmad al-Bushanji in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This biographical note describes al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn al-Mughira, known as al-Bushanji, a narrator from Iraq. He is characterized as 'mutarrib al-madhhab' (confused or unstable in his school of thought or theological stance), yet he is considered 'thiqa' (trustworthy) in the transmission of hadith.

en.tashayyu: 30 – al-Ḥusayn b. Aḥmad b. al-Mughīra, Abū ʿAbdillāh, al-Bushanjī, ʿIraqi.
Confused in madhhab, thiqa in his narration.
